headline: Conservation Board to discuss Natural Resource Overlay District Zoning Amendment, Comprehensive Plan resiliency priorities, and Conservation Legacy Fund grant applications.
summary: The board will consider draft zoning changes for rare, threatened, and endangered species protections, discuss resiliency priorities for the Comprehensive Plan, and review updates on the Conservation Legacy Fund grant application process.
items: Natural Resource Overlay District Zoning Amendment: consider draft changes for rare, threatened, and endangered species
Conservation Board Resiliency Priorities for the Comprehensive Plan: discuss and identify resiliency priorities
Conservation Legacy Fund Grant Application: updates and pilot program for upcoming grant period
plain_text:
Conservation Board Meeting Public Notice 
 
Monday, October 5, 2026, 5:30 PM  
  
311 North Avenue, Conference Room 
   
1. Minutes 
  
   1.1. Accept minutes from September 14, 2026 meeting  
2. Board Comment 
  
3. Public Comment 
  
4. Update & Discussion 
  
   4.1. Natural Resource Overlay District Zoning Amendment 
Consideration of draft changes to include provisions for rare, threatened, and endangered species  
   4.2. Conservation Board Resiliency Priorities for the Comprehensive Plan 
Discussion and identification of resiliency priorities to include in the Comp Plan  
   4.3. Conservation Legacy Fund Grant Application 
Updates & pilot program for the upcoming grant application period  
5. Adjournment
